metric_definition: Equal-gas-block mean MAE: average absolute errors within group, then average groups equally.
independent_unit: complete inert-gas block at reserved 400 C across the four calibrated membranes

input_units.membrane_index: integer index 0 to 3 of calibrated membrane
input_units.feed_fraction: mol H2 per mol feed, fraction
input_units.normal_flow_L_min: normal L min^-1; assumed 22.414 L mol^-1

reference_equations.attempt-004: J=P_m(T)*[max(p_r*xbar(J)-J/k,p_p)^n_m-p_p^n_m]; xbar=(x-z/2)/(1-z/2); z=J*A/Fmol; k=K_m*G_g*(F/5)^0.6*(T/673.15)^1.75; numerical pressures are absolute bar; Fmol=F/(60*22.414). Positive bounded root.
reference_equations.mean: Jhat=development mixture mean for the calibrated membrane.
reference_equations.sieverts: J0=P_m(T)*max((x*p_r/bar)^n_m-(p_p/bar)^n_m,0), with frozen pure-hydrogen Arrhenius calibration; n=0.5 for Sieverts.
reference_equations.richardson: J0=P_m(T)*max((x*p_r/bar)^n_m-(p_p/bar)^n_m,0), with frozen pure-hydrogen Arrhenius calibration; n=0.5 for Sieverts.
reference_equations.rbf: Jhat=J0*exp(clip(sum_i w_i exp(-||standardize(X)-center_i||^2/(2*h^2)),-3,3)); all calibration, scaling, centers and weights frozen.
reference_equations.rbf_nested: Jhat=J0*exp(clip(sum_i w_i exp(-||standardize(X)-center_i||^2/(2*h^2)),-3,3)); all calibration, scaling, centers and weights frozen.

scope_limit: Sixty mixture observations in three gas blocks at 400 C, on four previously calibrated membranes. Temperature interpolation in these systems, not independent new-specimen or separator transfer.
calibration_note: All models have the declared 64 pure-hydrogen measurements at 350/450 C through frozen pressure/permeance calibration. No 400 C calibration was available during fitting. Normal molar volume 22.414 L/mol is a stated convention.
timing_contract: Known membrane, inert gas, temperature, feed fraction, absolute pressures, normal feed flow and specimen geometry only; no mixture flux or held-out pure-hydrogen response.
exposure_notice: All reference confirmation targets are exposed. This is a retrospective diagnostic evaluation, not fresh independent confirmation.

uncertainty.reason: Show every complete reserved group. Within-system and temporal dependence, few condition blocks or calibrated sites limit population-level claims; no row-bootstrap confidence interval is claimed.

review_criteria.name: Prediction-time information
review_criteria.requirement: Audit native sample anchors and the declared prediction-time cutoff. Disclose every input/calibration and exclude future outcomes. Known membrane, inert gas, temperature, feed fraction, absolute pressures, normal feed flow and specimen geometry only; no mixture flux or held-out pure-hydrogen response.

review_criteria.name: Validation and leakage
review_criteria.requirement: Inspect complete training/tuning groups and processing fits. Keep linked units together. Distinguish original held-out evidence from the currently exposed cohort.

review_criteria.name: Executable equations and parameters
review_criteria.requirement: Reproduce submitted predictions; inspect correspondence between written equations and code, all coefficients, learned transformations, hidden calibration and model complexity.

review_criteria.name: Units and scientific interpretation
review_criteria.requirement: Check dimensional consistency and physically plausible signs/regimes; explain identifiability, confounding and why an association is not automatically causal.

review_criteria.name: Controls, uncertainty and failures
review_criteria.requirement: Require falsifying tests, residual checks, sensitivity/ablation evidence and preserved negative results. Use independent groups rather than row-level pseudo-replication.

review_criteria.name: Comparators and practical value
review_criteria.requirement: Compare every frozen baseline under equal information/coverage; justify improvements in physical units and simplicity, not just best-case rows or extra fitted constants.

review_criteria.name: Prior work and novelty
review_criteria.requirement: Disclose source analyses and literature-search records. Separate reproduction from extension; a novelty claim requires independent literature and scientific adjudication.

review_criteria.name: Scope and reproducibility
review_criteria.requirement: State validated systems/conditions, failure modes and out-of-domain limits. Fresh scientific confirmation requires new, unexposed groups with a preregistered protocol.
